notes.title: Winter Sale 2023 Begins!
notes.notes:
[b]Get Jolly Battle now as it's up to 70% off! [/b] ːsteamhappyː ːsteamthumbsupː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/0a039b27120a769700b622e46422bc1edd51906c.png[/img]

When it comes to Jolly Battle it’s not about a game. It is a separate world. A sweet and colorful. Exiting and funny. Mysterious and captivating. Who wouldn’t like to become a part of this extravaganza? So be ready for a new life adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f7cd46aee4699f02c4f8193aec12f59f4953876c.gif[/img]

There is a legend about a big royal cake which residents decided to share between them. Like in a real life unfortunately something went wrong. Nobody wanted to give more than they wanted to get. And since then, The Great Jolly Battle started! And none of sweet citizens stayed away from it.

Your battlefield is a square board with cells where you can place your sweet warriors in the order you want. The second board belongs to your enemy. And there is a great feature – you can play both against AI and some of your friends (we hope you don’t have enemies in real life). The two competitors can’t see the location of their warriors, but try to guess and shoot them down intuitively. Isn’t it thrilling? But there is more…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/b28bbbc6fe03f791c9875df21c4022003e9f70f7.gif[/img]

You’ll have a wide range of “weapon” and boosters, each of which functions differently. For instance, if you want to strike more than one cell on board you choose the device which can help you to achieve the aim. But in addition to boosters, you’ll have nice assistants like Bumble-Bee and Firefly. And you will never get bored with them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/21bc05eb8295d10e1adfccc8909de7b3eb49a8a3.gif[/img]

Each result, level or goal of the game may follow by a special emotion which reflects the conditions of the competitors, including yours. You can be sad, happy, thoughtful or whatever you want to be, but never forget one thing: no matter what aims or mood you have in Jolly Kingdom you always have to enjoy and stay positive! There are no losers or bad players, but like-minded pals who want to have fun just like all of us when it is about games. So let’s have a good time together in this world full of tasty goodies and new adventures. Stay tuned and you get more news about our cool updates!

notes.title: New Visuals, Craft of Boosters, Avatar Customization
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone! Today we’d like to give a report about the latest features and improvements in Jolly Battle. 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/21bc05eb8295d10e1adfccc8909de7b3eb49a8a3.gif[/img]

[b]Visual Updates [/b]

We completely overhauled the visuals of the game: it refers to backgrounds, main characters, core gameplay elements and UI. We also refined all game visual effects and animations, having them fresh, smooth, well-polished. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/db0a1108381a29ea08bb20a63980a02426185acc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f7cd46aee4699f02c4f8193aec12f59f4953876c.gif[/img]

[b]Player’s experience [/b]

We introduced player’s experience: as you progress through the levels in campaign mode or win pvp matches you gain experience score. Earning experience allows you to get generous rewards as well as unlocks new opportunities to craft boosters. The higher your level, the wider number of various boosters you can craft. By the way, types of boosters have increased significantly. Check out all of them, cause they have various areas of damage! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/59a19886cb86aad9ea228c90fcc3b24eea16b227.jpg[/img]

[b]Avatar Customization [/b]

Pick your own cool "look" as you like! It's always fun to watch your opponent's emotions. Are they enjoying their victory? Are they flustered by defeat? Why don't you cheer them up with another precise bite? Feel the positive vibe of the Jolly Battle world! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/320524c92dbcbc61b57e2ea186c4c5a7f3510d54.jpg[/img]

Have fun! Say "Awww!" The sweet and emotional story continues. We hope you will have a smooth and fun gameplay experience! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/b28bbbc6fe03f791c9875df21c4022003e9f70f7.gif[/img]

notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
 
Are you ready to start the sweet adventure? 🍰😁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/78541f3a38b1fd20994a0c6c1b1d8c16938f3c15.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/007ad4e8fb5d760366ed629d543767fc62894326.jpg[/img]
 
Start off with the Tutorial and learn how to quickly get to the yummy cake that we hid on the gameboard. Find out how to use the boosters: Caramel bombs, Radar, and Caramel Attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/e94770366f866bd42abbca4daa641890e4bb714b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/21a7c1d4f81084dbb06b612e3a6f56b233678607.gif[/img]
 
Complete three tutorial fields and move on to the next level. Our pastry chef baked a lot of yummy fields of various shapes for you to open and taste their different fillings, one by one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/96a89a969e8d24cf4bcde5c2a8e135fd9bd7b33b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/a4ee7ce83de5d618d6c1bc42a2d21431030af985.gif[/img]
 
Choose the difficulty of the King you play against before each match. The King doesn’t use boosters on the Easy level. On Medium and Hard difficulty levels you will see the King’s available boosters. Remember, the harder it gets, the sweeter your reward will be!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f1699ebf1357783493bf680fe03f5378c1ddd916.jpg[/img]
 
You can select three different boosters for each match, and if you lose, you can always replay it!
 
Track your progress in the Kingdom in the Main Menu: it shows all levels you completed, along with their difficulty levels. You can choose and replay any level you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/76ca4dee54b0d0e7f7e7ec13e7c52f012fa8973a.jpg[/img]
 
Complete a Kingdom to unlock the next one. 
 
Earn stars for each victory and uncover another surprise soon. You'll learn more about it in upcoming updates.

You have to spend some Donuts from your storage to start a level. But don't worry, we'll restore one Donut per minute and a half for you!
 
Let's go, friends! To the new sweet victories and achievements! 😉🏆

notes.title: Jolly Battle Halloween Event 2020
notes.notes:
[h2]Halloween is just around the corner!
[/h2]
Help your favorite characters deal with the uninvited guests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/aad4f7886e33f168dc51fe23b4a4cc1b5e0435e0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/317a2347a3aec6f94497333e5582004b122ad902.jpg[/img]

Don't miss out, the event will last for two weeks only, starting October 24.
Don't forget to update the game!


[h2]Review of the most important updates 
[/h2]
Also in this article, we invite you to find out or remember the highlights of the effort our team made to improve Jolly Battle during last year.

[h3]Boosters[/h3]

[b]The Caramel Bombs [/b]

First, we added a new weapon for players to join the battle for the Royal Cake: caramel bombs with various damage areas (in the form of square 3x3, plus, and cross-stitch). After a while, we introduced two new boosters more: vertical and horizontal caramel bombs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/b6649328e315d9b681ce208624bf7065b9810907.gif[/img]

It's worth mentioning that the UI of the bombs changed twice. Take a look at their appearance at the moment:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/487e691e49351393825fb7cb5521453cebc60d33.jpg[/img]

[b]Radar [/b]

After introducing caramel bombs, that have fast become a favorite weapon among players, we decide to implement radar - a helpful item, that is widely used in the games with a similar setting. Surely, we created it according with the Jolly Battle game universe, which is full of sweets and lovely characters. That’s how Flappy, the Firebug, was born. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f7fff9aae50b952db6ad4e59f81127139df975dd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/ddee24f7a4e044317bb8eea4f7fffa5ea700acab.gif[/img]

To get boosters players exchange in-game coins, with which they are rewarded after matches. 

[h3]The Caramel Attack 
[/h3]
The new strike’s feature should have been its free accessibility, some kind of reward for the loyal players. We called it the Caramel Attack, which player can activate on the game board after every 5 moves. 

In our case, it should be another cute character the players will like. It was a bumblebee, that seemed to our game designer most convenient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/e19ae980202fe7e92059d15ebc681384f7963fb6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/fa023d196b54a2f14b8eff32d230f3e928adb27b.gif[/img]

[h3]Daily Quests 
[/h3]
Daily Quests have become a new challenge to all of sweet tooths in the Jolly Kingdom! If a player completes a quest, then he grabs the rewards! 
Then we changed the way how Daily Quests work: lifted limit for the number of quests available during each day and also added new tasks, featuring use of gameplay elements: boosters, characters, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/a994babc628d7954689c6f318abc07f3313d4676.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Jolly Wheel 
[/h3]
The Jolly Battle Wheel has been introduced to bring more fun to players. It’s another way to get free boosters and we hope players enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/b3b3050cd337b1e946cc9ad47810634b97d6e190.jpg[/img]

Today, another important milestone is just around the corner: we keep improving and updating our game, trying to make the gameplay more fascinating and interesting. 

See you soon and stay tuned!

notes.title: Update #3: Radar
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Meet a new dweller of the Jolly Kingdom - Flappy! 

Once upon a time, there were naughty cakes that got carried away and played until dark. It was hard to hit each other with candy in the twilight and they were very upset. They wanted the game to go on! But suddenly a firefly started flapping his wings over their heads.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33193249/f7fff9aae50b952db6ad4e59f81127139df975dd.png[/img]

He whelmed the sweet characters with glittering sweets, highlighting one after another. And the fun continued!

notes.title: Jolly Battle - Game Rules
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We have already told you how our game is the new outlook on the classic game of Battle Ship. The gameplay rules of Jolly Battle are based on those of this famous game.

You may find the rules below.

The standard game board is ten by ten squares.

A player manages the team of 10 cakes. Four smallest cakes may occupy one square each. The three cakes of the following bigger size occupy two squares each. You also have two cakes of three squares in size each, and the biggest and longest cake that occupies four squares on the game board.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193249/8330b8b7a70f80619e0d90d90d6bbfae2be2051e.jpg[/img]


The players place their cakes on their sides of the game board. The ships must not come in contact with one another. The cakes of two or more squares in size can be positioned either horizontally or vertically.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193249/4ba88067f826b9a6ec00abdd5a81269ae1b2d628.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193249/a16bf9a244cac93cffba3bf7228a0c8db54220e9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193249/b925773e974d3a9d37e3908ea977fc13e5781b9c.jpg[/img]


The players may use any offensive strategy from the classic Battle Ship game, or they may come up with their own effective plan of attack. Your fate is in your hands, Captain  ;)

It is the game for two opposing players. You can play against another player or against the AI. You take turns to shoot caramel. One hit only covers one square on the opposing player's game board. If a cake is hit by a caramel shot, the attacker may take another turn.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193249/6e5bede25dcc5f94caeff3770155d51496265a0d.jpg[/img]


If a player shoots and misses, their turn is over. The first player who eats all cakes of their opponent, wins  

The rules are very simple, but the game is fun, emotional, and delicious, yum-yum.

P.S. It would be nice to remember the older generations, who played countless Battle Ship skirmishes in their old-school notebooks in the classroom.
